_comment: Analyze Trade decision packet (#792) parameters. Read by src/trade/analyze_trade.py. Every value here is a PRIOR: a declared, evidence-gated judgement, not a calibrated fit. There is no outcome data yet to calibrate a trade-recommendation threshold against; changing one is an owner-visible methodology change.

rosterUtility.materialityPpgRationale: Below 1.0 expected best-ball points per week (about 17 points over a season) a lineup change is treated as neutral, and never below twice the estimate's own Monte-Carlo standard error.

decision._comment: v3 modifiers (#792 Batch 4). Every value is a PRIOR: declared, not fitted; there is no outcome data to calibrate a recommendation threshold against. Changing one is an owner-visible methodology change. See docs/trade/ANALYZE_TRADE_V3_METHODOLOGY.md.
decision.lowConfidenceShareMediumRationale: A quarter of the traded value resting on low-confidence canonical stamps caps the decision's confidence at MEDIUM.
decision.lowConfidenceShareLowRationale: Half of the traded value low-confidence caps it at LOW.
decision.benchmarkCoverageMinRationale: KTC Market disagreement caps confidence only when the benchmark prices at least half of the traded canonical value; thinner coverage is reported, not acted on.
decision.agingAgeRationale: Start of the canonical 28_30 age band (src/roster_intel/age_portfolio.AGE_BANDS).
decision.agingShareMinRationale: A REBUILD team taking on mostly aging value without a canonical-value edge is one step toward PASS.
decision.titleDeltaMaterialPpRationale: Title-odds change (percentage points) a PUSH team needs, significant under paired seeds, before the posture fit steps toward MAKE; below it, paying value steps toward PASS.
